headline: Hitachi Astemo Halts Zhongshan Production Due to Ransomware Attack on Systems
body: Following a disruptive ransomware attack, Hitachi Astemo Chassis Systems (Zhongshan) Ltd. has suspended production at its facilities. The assault encrypted crucial execution and logistics systems, bringing operations to a standstill. In response, external cybersecurity experts have been called in to mitigate the situation. While efforts are underway to restore normal activities, the company has yet to provide an estimated timeline for resuming full operations.
